goals.description: Mbappé cut in from the left side of the box and fired a right-footed shot into the top right corner after a pass from Désiré Doué.
Dembélé struck a right-footed shot from outside the box into the bottom right corner, set up by Mbappé.

matches.notes: France won 2-0 in 90 minutes. Kylian Mbappé had a 28th-minute penalty saved by Yassine Bounou after Noussair Mazraoui fouled him; Mbappé later scored and assisted before going off injured at 77'.

goals.description: Fabián Ruiz finished with a right-footed shot from the centre of the box into the high centre of the goal.
Timothy Castagne crossed and Charles De Ketelaere headed in from the centre of the box to equalise.
Substitute Mikel Merino scored with a left-footed shot from very close range into the top left corner.

matches.notes: Spain won 2-1 in 90 minutes; substitute Mikel Merino scored the 88th-minute winner two minutes after coming on. Belgium goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois went off injured at 71'.

goals.description: Andreas Schjelderup received from Martin Ødegaard on the left side of the box and curled a left-footed shot into the top right corner.
Anthony Gordon set up Jude Bellingham, who finished low with his left foot from the left side of the box beyond Ørjan Nyland in first-half stoppage time.
After a corner, Nyland could only parry Morgan Rogers' effort and Bellingham reacted first to force the rebound in with his right foot.

var.detail: Goal by Torbjørn Heggem (55') ruled out after VAR review for a foul by Erling Haaland. VAR Decision: No Goal Norway 1-1 England.

matches.notes: England won 2-1 after extra time (1-1 after 90 minutes). Torbjørn Heggem's 55th-minute goal for Norway was disallowed after a VAR review (foul by Haaland). Jude Bellingham scored both England goals.

goals.description: From a corner, Lionel Messi crossed and Alexis Mac Allister headed in from the left side of the six-yard box.
Ricardo Rodríguez's through ball found Dan Ndoye, who scored with a right-footed shot from a difficult angle on the left.
Julián Álvarez hit a right-footed shot from outside the box into the top right corner after a pass from José Manuel López.
On a fast break in added time, Lautaro Martínez finished with a right-footed shot from the centre of the box into the bottom right corner.

cards.reason: Second yellow card (simulation, confirmed after VAR review)

var.detail: VAR Decision: Card Changed. (ESPN commentary; reports say Breel Embolo's second yellow for simulation followed a VAR review)

matches.notes: Argentina won 3-1 after extra time (1-1 after 90 minutes). Switzerland's Breel Embolo was sent off with a second yellow card for simulation in the 72nd minute after a VAR review; Julián Álvarez and Lautaro Martínez scored in extra time.

goals.description: Lamine Yamal drew a foul from Lucas Digne in the box and Mikel Oyarzabal converted the penalty with his left foot into the top right corner.
Pedro Porro played a give-and-go with Dani Olmo and finished with a right-footed shot from the centre of the box into the bottom right corner.

matches.notes: Spain won 2-0 in 90 minutes to reach their first World Cup final since 2010. France lost William Saliba to injury after 30 minutes.

goals.description: Morgan Rogers crossed and Anthony Gordon finished with his right foot from very close range into the bottom left corner.
After a corner, Lionel Messi laid the ball off and Enzo Fernández drove a right-footed shot from outside the box into the bottom left corner.
Lionel Messi crossed and substitute Lautaro Martínez headed in from very close range in stoppage time.

matches.notes: Argentina came from behind to win 2-1 in 90 minutes, with both goals from Lionel Messi assists: Enzo Fernández equalised in the 85th minute and Lautaro Martínez headed the winner in stoppage time.

goals.description: Declan Rice opened the scoring inside three minutes with a right-footed shot from outside the box into the bottom right corner.
Declan Rice's corner was headed in by Ezri Konsa from the centre of the box.
England broke quickly and Marcus Rashford set up Bukayo Saka, who finished left-footed from the left side of the box.
Eberechi Eze's through ball sent Saka clear to score left-footed into the bottom right corner in first-half stoppage time.
On a counter-attack, Michael Olise's through ball found Kylian Mbappé, who finished left-footed into the bottom right corner.
Mbappé slipped a through ball to substitute Bradley Barcola, who scored right-footed into the bottom left corner.
Olise set up Mbappé again for a left-footed finish from the centre of the box to make it 3-4.
Djed Spence was fouled in the box by Malo Gusto and Saka converted the penalty left-footed into the bottom right corner to complete his hat-trick.
On a fast break, Dayot Upamecano set up Ousmane Dembélé for a left-footed finish into the bottom left corner.
Jude Bellingham sealed the win on a fast break with a right-footed shot from the centre of the box into the bottom right corner.

matches.notes: England won the third-place match 6-4 in 90 minutes after leading 4-0 at half-time. Bukayo Saka scored a hat-trick; Kylian Mbappé scored twice. It was Didier Deschamps' last match as France coach.

goals.description: Nico Williams nodded the ball on and Ferran Torres struck a left-footed shot from the centre of the box into the high centre of the goal.

matches.notes: Spain won the World Cup 1-0 after extra time (0-0 after 90 minutes), their second title. Argentina played with ten men from 90+3' after Enzo Fernández's second yellow card; Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute.
